title: Non-thread-safe static `HashMap` initializations
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.beta.custom_build [bb92a4c8e]

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta (bb92a4c8e) - Fedora Linux 42 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (RADV NAVI23) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-12100F (8 threads) - 31.14 GiB memory

### Issue description

I looked for more cases like #113210 that might cause crashes when multiple threads try to initialize the same `HashMap` at the same time, and found the methods below:
- `Color::find_named_color`
- `VariantParser::parse_value` (for typed arrays/dictionaries)
- `EngineUpdateLabel::_get_version_type`
- `_find_annotation_arguments` (in gdscript_editor.cpp)

The `Color` and `VariantParser` cases can cause crashes with the gdscript below.  I only see crashes around 1 in 20 times, though the `Color` case will often print the error `ERROR: Invalid color name: yellow.`.  Not sure if the other methods can be run on multiple threads, but might be good to update all of them to use thread-safe initialization just to be safe.

### Steps to reproduce

Can be reproduced in new project with gdscript below, comment/uncomment the `thread.start` lines to switch between `Color`/`VariantParser` cases

```gdscript
func _ready():
	var threads : Array[Thread] = []
	for i in 10:
		threads.push_back(Thread.new())
	
	for thread in threads:
		thread.start(_color_test.bind("yellow"))
		#thread.start(_typed_array_test)

	for thread in threads:
		thread.wait_to_finish()

	print("Finished")

func _color_test(color: String):
	Color(color)

func _typed_array_test():
	str_to_var("Array[int]([1, 2, 3])")
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A, see script above
